transcript: I applied to 518 jobs and got 28 interviews including Google. And this is how you can get a job with 100% guarantee. There's a free Claude plugin on GitHub called Career-Ops that turns your entire job search into an automated system using connectors. So it evaluates each job against your actual experience, and scores each job through A and F. For every job worth your time and salary, it writes fully customized ATS friendly resume and a cover letter like for each job. Then it finds gaps between your resume and the job description and tells you exactly how to fix them before the interview. Also builds STAR stories mapped to that specific role for the interview. And on top of everything, it also writes outreach message to the hiring manager. And once you land the job offer, it gives you negotiation scripts with salary framework. So to set it up, go to this GitHub repo, download the zip file, link is in the comments. Then open Claude Cowork and upload the file in new plugins. To automate the job search, go to Apify and create a free account. Enable the LinkedIn Jobs Scraper actor, and then copy your API token. Then go back to Claude Cowork and install the Apify connector. Now simply drop your existing resume or tell Claude about your dream job, and it will do the rest for you.
